nodes.description: Owner address of UniswapExchange; assigned from msg.sender in the constructor and used as the only access-control guard.
Public mapping of token balances; mutated by transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spending allowances; mutated by approve and transferFrom.
Private mapping whitelisting addresses that bypass the sale restriction check in ensure().
Private mapping counting how many times each address has sold; incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Private max number of sales per address, set by init() and read in condition().
Private minimum sale amount, set by init() and read in condition().
Private maximum sale amount, set by init() and read in condition().
Address exempted from sale restrictions; written by setTradeAddress and read by ensure().
Public total token supply, set once in the constructor.
Public constant decimals used to scale supply and sale limits.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address whitelisted inside ensure().
ERC20 transfer entry point that forwards msg.sender to transferFrom.
Internal gatekeeper that whitelists owner/tradeAddress/UNI/pair and otherwise enforces condition().
Core transfer logic; performs allowance and balance arithmetic without SafeMath and calls ensure().
Sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender] to _value.
Internal view enforcing sale count and min/max sale amount limits.
Owner-only function performing a delegatecall into an arbitrary address.
Owner-only initializer that configures sale limits and count.
Owner-only batch distribution of tokens using unchecked balance arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Deterministic Uniswap V2 pair address computation used by ensure().
Constructor assigning name, symbol, supply, owner and initial balances/allowances.
SafeERC20 helper that executes a low-level call to an ERC20 token.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, transfers and approvals.
Delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address inside delegate().
Low-level address(token).call(data) in callOptionalReturn.
Raw subtraction/addition on balanceOf and allowance without SafeMath.

edges.reason: transfer() forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
ensure() falls through to condition() for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure() reads canSale[_from] to whitelist sellers.
ensure() reads tradeAddress as a whitelisted sender.
ensure() compares _from with the constant UNI router address.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the expected pair address.
condition() reads _saleNum to bound per-address sales.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
condition() compares _minSale with _value.
condition() compares _value with _maxSale.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to].
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
transferFrom performs raw balanceOf/allowance arithmetic without SafeMath, risking underflow.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
init() writes _minSale.
init() writes _maxSale.
init() writes _saleNum.
init() scales limits using decimals.
batchSend credits balanceOf for each recipient.
batchSend uses unchecked multiplication and balance subtraction/addition.
delegate() executes an arbitrary address delegatecall, a privileged and dangerous operation.
callOptionalReturn performs the low-level call to the token contract.
setTradeAddress writes tradeAddress.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets totalSupply from _supply*10**decimals.
Constructor mints full supply to msg.sender in balanceOf.
Constructor grants unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
msg.sender is used as _from for allowance and self-transfer checks in transferFrom.
approve() keys allowance on msg.sender.
delegate() gates execution on msg.sender == owner.
init() gates execution on msg.sender == owner.
batchSend() gates execution on msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress() gates execution on msg.sender == owner.
Constructor sets the privileged owner from msg.sender.
_from drives allowance and balance reads in transferFrom.
_from is whitelist-checked inside ensure().
_to receives the credited balance in transferFrom.
_value is the amount moved in transferFrom.
_value is passed into the ensure()/condition() limit checks.
_value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
_tos array supplies batchSend recipients.
User-supplied address a is the target of the delegatecall.
User-supplied bytes b is the delegatecall payload.
saleNum parameter written into _saleNum.
token parameter written into _minSale.
maxToken parameter written into _maxSale.
addr parameter stored as tradeAddress.
total local accumulates _value * _tos.length.
Loop index i controls the batchSend iteration.
Per-iteration _to taken from _tos.
Per-iteration _to is credited in balanceOf.

normalization_plan.reason: _from is a function parameter consumed entirely by transferFrom/ensure balance and whitelist logic.
_to is a function parameter consumed by transferFrom to credit balances.
_value is a function parameter used by transferFrom for allowance and balance arithmetic.
_tos is a function parameter iterated only by batchSend.
a is the user-controlled target address of the delegatecall.
b is the user-controlled calldata passed to the delegatecall.
saleNum is a function parameter written into _saleNum by init.
token is a function parameter written into _minSale by init.
maxToken is a function parameter written into _maxSale by init.
addr is a function parameter stored in tradeAddress by setTradeAddress.
total is a local computed and spent inside batchSend.
i is the loop index local of batchSend.
_to is a per-iteration local recipient inside batchSend.
